To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) SSE-PT is a new personalized recommendation model that outperforms state-of-the-art models on 5 real world datasets; 2) SSE-PT++ can handle very long sequences with a small modification and outperform the state of art model on a dataset with extremely long sequences; 3) SSE-PT can be used to generate more interpretable and personalized results.

(1) SSE-PT is a state-of-the-art personalized sequential recommender that outperforms the previous state-of-the-art model SASRec by 5%, (2) the SSE-PT is more interpretable than SASRec, (3) SSE-PT can be used to handle extremely long sequences with comparable speed to SASRec, and (4) the SSE-regularization is the key to the success of SSE-PT.

we propose a novel personalization method for the Transformer model that is based on stochastic shared embeddings, outperforming the state-of-the-art model on 5 real datasets and is more interpretable, and that a simple modification of our model can handle extremely long sequence data and is more scalable than the state-of-the art.

the following three questions: 1. Can we personalize a state-of-the-art recommendation model that uses a Transformer architecture? 2. How can we handle extremely long user engagement sequences? 3. How can we make the model more interpretable and focus on recent user preferences?
